1 Scope1.1 This standard describes procedure for preparation of copper and copperalloys surfaces for electroplating. It, however, does not cover powdered metalparts of copper alloys. Only alloys containing at least 50 percent copper bymass, considered within the scope of this practice.
1.1 This standard describes procedure for preparation of copper and copperalloys surfaces for electroplating. It, however, does not cover powdered metalparts of copper alloys. Only alloys containing at least 50 percent copper bymass, considered within the scope of this practice.
